MCPToolProvider~gogoShell.name: gogo_shell_tool_provider
MCPToolProvider~gogoShell.description: A tool provider that collects Gogo shell tools for executing commands in a running OSGi framework

HttpMCPServerComponent~gogoShell.server.name: osgi-gogo-mcp-server
HttpMCPServerComponent~gogoShell.server.instructions: Use this MCP server to interact with a live OSGi runtime. You can execute any Gogo shell command to inspect bundles, DS components, services, configurations, and more. Start with 'list_commands' to see what's available, then use 'execute_gogo' to run specific commands.

MCPToolProvider~emfModel.name: emf_model_tool_provider
MCPToolProvider~emfModel.description: Tools to create, populate, validate and serialize EMF model instances from allow-listed EPackages

HttpMCPServerComponent~emfModel.server.name: osgi-emf-mcp-server
HttpMCPServerComponent~emfModel.server.instructions: Use this MCP server to build EMF model instances from natural-language constraints. Start with list_metamodel and describe_eclass to discover the available metamodel, then create_dataset + create_instance + modify_feature to build objects step by step. Inspect with inspect_dataset (includeRecipe=true returns a replayable build recipe), validate and serialize with export_dataset (XMI or JSON). create_from_json builds a whole instance graph in one call; replay_recipe deterministically reproduces a dataset from a recipe without LLM involvement. Note: only allow-listed EPackages/EClasses are visible and instantiable (deny-all by default).
